decision_target: Select an internal transport model for a request-scoped debate run.
question: Should the demo use shared memory, local files, or TCP for temporary debate-worker communication?
scope: Phase-1 demo runtime on one local machine.
constraints: router must not inspect payload semantics
material_conditions: no production remote trust requirement yet

candidate_stances.claim: Use leader-owned in-process routing for the first demo runtime.
candidate_stances.why: The first demo must validate lifecycle, ordering, adjudication, cleanup, and causal output before adding transport complexity.
assumptions: all workers run on one local machine
demo does not need production isolation yet

evidence.relevance: demo closure does not require production distributed transport

candidate_stances.action_impact: Implement the first runtime with a pluggable worker adapter and in-process demo worker factory.
candidate_stances.risk_if_wrong: Transport assumptions may need replacement when real nested-codex process isolation becomes mandatory.
invalidation_conditions: workers must run on separate machines
process isolation becomes part of the demo success criteria

candidate_stances.claim: Use local filesystem mailbucket folders for every internal worker message.
candidate_stances.why: Filesystem artifacts are inspectable and align with existing envelope/mailbucket concepts.
assumptions: message inspection is more important than speed

evidence.relevance: mailbucket model exists at the top-level communication layer

candidate_stances.action_impact: Persist every worker turn as a file artifact.
candidate_stances.risk_if_wrong: The demo may over-couple internal debate transport to top-level mailbucket semantics.
invalidation_conditions: internal worker traffic becomes too frequent for file-per-turn overhead

candidate_stances.claim: Use TCP sockets for internal worker communication from the beginning.
candidate_stances.why: TCP can later support distributed workers and stronger process separation.
candidate_stances.scope: Future distributed runtime, not necessarily the first local demo.
candidate_stances.action_impact: Implement a socket transport and worker addressing layer immediately.
candidate_stances.risk_if_wrong: The runtime may overbuild production transport before validating the department mechanism.
invalidation_conditions: the project requires remote worker execution in the demo phase
